Sample25 Ring8 preserved an original nine-input native rejection boundary.
Playing Eager Conscript in room2 adds Fun Guy12 to the champion's primary
troop cache: Horde1 health4 becomes7 with exactly the original third-tier
health3 upgrade, and the next primary update retains cache [2,5,12] and HP7.
The enemy-only Fragile boss buff is the sole active enchantment source.

Release291 accepts this exact primary-mode composition; third-tier preview
births and other source signatures remain guarded. The focused check compares
all nine native successors, forecasts and RNG, four immutable branches, and
six changed-signature controls. The existing second-tier Titanskin independent
native pair remains valid. Frozen revision 41473650 independently reproduced
the same nine inputs and complete successors, forecasts and RNG, preserving
the original rejection and the repaired prediction. The whole Ring8 battle
remains a separate acceptance step.
